name: align-uncaptured-revert-to-base-text
description: e1 changes `LEVEL = 3` to `LEVEL = 4`. Afterwards, with no captured edit, something puts the original text back, so the final file is byte for byte the base file. The final `LEVEL = 3` is Unknown(noCapture), NOT base: content equality never transfers origin (rule 1), and the line exists only because of the uncaptured change (rule 5). The two untouched lines stay base.
